item.title: Authentik: setting up a Reputation Policy
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step setup of the Reputation Policy and GeoIP in Authentik for restricting access by IP reputation and country, with a breakdown of typical protection scenarios.

item.title: Setting up email notifications in Authentik
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to setting up email notifications in Authentik: connecting SMTP, enabling event notifications, configuring email templates, and verifying delivery.

item.title: Cloudflare Turnstile in Authentik - setting up login form protection
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)

item.title: Setting up two-factor authentication in Authentik
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)

item.title: Setting up user enrollment and invitation processes in Authentik
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A guide to setting up the enrollment and invitation flow in Authentik: registering new users, invitations, stages, flows, and access policies.

item.title: Setting up password recovery in Authentik
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)

item.title: Authentik: initial setup after installation
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed overview of the initial setup of Authentik - an open source system for centralized authentication and authorization (IdP/SSO). We’ll walk through the very first steps of setting up Authentik.

item.title: OIDC, OAuth2, and Proxy Provider in Authentik - how to protect any application
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed explanation of how Authentik’s Proxy Provider adds authentication and SSO to any application. A simple flow diagram, key concepts, and usage examples.

item.title: Vaultwarden — server installation, an alternative to Bitwarden
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)

item.title: Authentik overview: architecture, features, and comparison with Keycloak
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A detailed overview of Authentik - an open-source system for centralized authentication and authorization (IdP/SSO). We’ll cover why IAM solutions are needed, the architecture, key features, and a comparison with alternatives.

item.title: TOTP vs WebAuthn vs Passwordless - what's the difference and which one to choose
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)

item.title: Installing Authelia in Docker | Complete Guide

item.title: Installing and Configuring Keycloak

item.title: ZITADEL - A Modern Open-Source IAM Solution
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
